data.gender_notes: Juwayriya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman of great valor and courage. Derived from the Arabic root 'w-r-y' meaning 'to be strong'. In the Quran, Juwayriya is the name of a noblewoman who defended her people and religion against an invading army. The name Juwayriya carries the meaning “Brave woman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juwayriya usually hope their child will grow to embody brave woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juwayriya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
